column1: # Every browser cache of a server answer in the production client (tests/frontend/helpers/browser-caches.mjs finds them:
# a value kept across calls (module state, or state a closure holds: a factory's arrays and maps), or browser storage,
# written in a function that awaits a read) and how it follows the signed-in person's access. Columns: file (under js/),
# name, class, reason. Classes: uncached = only a read in flight is shared; revisioned = kept under the person's access
# revision (core/access-revision.js: the X-JE-Revision every JE answer carries, the bootstrap's, and a probe on every
# navigation and when the tab comes back into view, whatever features are on) and read again, in place, when it moves
# ('je-access-revision'), and on a user switch; document = a mirror of one of the person's documents that decides what
# is hidden or protected (Hidden Content, Spoiler Guard), kept under that document's revision and read again in place
# when it moves ('je-document-revision': another tab or device saved it); revalidated = the server is asked every time
# and the kept copy only answers an unchanged reply; shared = the same for everyone; own = the person's own display
# preference, changed by themselves (no access or protection decision rests on it; another tab's change shows at the
# next page load); item = Jellyfin's own answer about an item, drawn only on that item's own page or player, which
# Jellyfin authorizes on every visit; account = the person's Seerr account link or the page bootstrap, which the server
# checks again on every read and request; state = not an answer (timers, controllers, positions, UI state, bookkeeping).
# The core response cache (js/core/api-client.js) keeps only the prefixes in its SHARED_CACHE_PREFIXES.
